title: Road Hazard Protection Tire Replacement Terms
content:
## Rule
Under Road Hazard Protection, a covered tire that cannot be repaired is replaced with the same tire at a Crestline store and the plan pays a share of the replacement tire's price.

**Per-position limit.** Each wheel position may be replaced only as many times as the plan allows. The limit is the plan's covered replacements per wheel position, counted over the certificate's replacement entries and out-of-area replacement reimbursement entries on that position together.

**Full replacement (clause R1).** The plan pays 100 percent while both hold: the service date is on or before the effective date plus the plan's full-replacement months, counted as calendar months to the same day of the month (falling back to the last day of that month), and the tread worn (the tire line's original tread depth, from the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty line, less the measured remaining tread) is at most the plan's full-replacement wear figure.

**Prorated share (clause R2).** Otherwise the coverage percentage is the remaining usable tread (the measured remaining tread less the plan's coverage tread limit) divided by the original usable tread (the line's original tread depth less the coverage tread limit), times 100, rounded down to a whole percent.

**Plan's share (clause R3).** The amount the plan pays is the coverage percentage of the replacement price (the current selling price of the same tire on the service date), rounded half up to the cent.

**What the customer pays.** The replacement price less the plan's share, plus the replacement tire's mounting and balancing unless the plan includes mounting, plus its valve stem or TPMS kit and disposal fee unless the plan includes them, those charges being the ones of the tire's line. When the plan covers TPMS sensor damage, a sensor destroyed by the same hazard is replaced free. The damaged tire is kept by Crestline. When the plan makes the replacement tire stay covered, the new tire stays covered to the expiration date; otherwise the position is no longer covered.

The per-plan figures — replacements per position, full-replacement months and full-replacement wear — are those of the plan's replacement benefit table.

## Clauses retired in part
- Clause R1 is **no longer in force** for a covered replacement at a Crestline store that the holder authorizes in person on the day the store's technician inspects the damaged tire; that replacement is figured under the store-replacement authorization terms. R1 stays in force for every other replacement.
- Clauses R2 and R3 are **no longer in force** for (a) a covered replacement that a Crestline store has already carried out at its counter on a certificate whose claim history does not yet carry it, the technician's damage reading being dated before the posting day, and (b) a covered replacement at a Crestline store that the holder authorizes in person on the day the store's technician inspects the damaged tire; each of those is figured under its own current terms and booked as a replacement entry under a new claim number. R2 and R3 stay in force for every other replacement.

## Worked example (hypothetical, clauses R2 and R3)
A tire line with 11/32 inch new tread, a 2/32 inch coverage limit, a measured tread of 5/32 inch outside the full-replacement period: usable tread 3 of 9, times 100, is 33.33, rounded down to 33 percent. At a hypothetical current selling price of 140.00 the plan pays 46.20 and the customer pays 93.80 plus any installation items the plan does not include.

superseded_clauses: amount is coverage_pct percent of replacement_price (the current selling price of the same tire on the service date), rounded half up to the cent.

Otherwise coverage_pct is the remaining usable tread (remaining_tread_32nds minus coverage_min_tread_32nds) divided by the original usable tread (hazard_msr_original_tread minus coverage_min_tread_32nds), times 100, rounded down to a whole percent.
The plan pays 100 percent while both hold: hazard_msr_within_full_months is true and the tread worn (hazard_msr_original_tread minus remaining_tread_32nds) is at most full_replacement_wear_32nds.
